- Escort: We will have a greeter + escort for CEO arrival (Soojin to staff). Escort will meet Michael at curb; will walk to a private prep room (Room B) 10 minutes prior to briefing.
- AV & hotspot: Marissa, can you confirm dedicated hotspot + mic check at 09:30? Also confirm that Room B has a monitor + temporary whiteboard.
- Catering: Note Priya's shellfish allergy — alt lunch (gluten-free / vegetarian) for Priya and Michael's preference noted as pescatarian.

Attachments: [SummitWave_Onsite_BadgeList.xlsx] (badge roster, names/IDs), [summit_run_of_show_v2.pdf] (attached)

Action items (owners):
- Marissa Cole: Confirm AV hotspot, confirm whiteboard + prep room setup by 6/18 EOD.
- Jordan Blake: Confirm vehicle logistics, driver name, drop-off/pickup windows; submit driver manifest to security by 6/18.
- Laura Bennett: Prepare a printed EA pocket brief for Michael and one for Priya (1-page each) 

I'll meet Ravi on Mon 6/19 at 14:30 for the badge handoff in the Redwood lobby. Priya — if there are any last-minute attendee changes, please send by EOD Friday so we can reprint badges.

Thanks all,

--
